[Lucy O'Shea]() will present the ... . 
[aaa](), [bbb](), and [ccc]() will present their startups currently in the DLAB and will explain how they took their code and began making money from it.


[Register](https://vu-nl.libcal.com/calendar/universitylibrary/Bytes_and_Bites_Nov_2026)


Have you been working on a project and thought "I wonder if I could make money from this?", well sometimes you can. In this November edition of Bytes & Bites we will talk about how you can start a business whilst working or studying at the VU and what that process looks like. We will see several CEOs discuss their current business, the highs and lows, and the process of taking a concept and messy code base to a product.

Pizza will be served as always!
